title: Make the chorus yours
description: Choose a chorus you have permission to use. Find four eight-count phrases and make each ending clear.
prompts: Practice the transitions at a slower tempo
Record one full take without stopping

title: One sharp eight
description: A short phrase, full commitment. Work on isolations, clean accents and a deliberate final shape.
prompts: Choose eight counts of your own movement
Separate the accents from the transitions
Film a relaxed take and a full-energy take

title: Your one-take moment
description: Bring your own routine to a complete one-take cover. Tell the community which part you practiced most.
prompts: Warm up and mark your floor space
Run the routine once at comfortable energy
Share a single continuous take with your practice note
